200.description:
One NWS alert by CAP id from /alerts/{id}: full description and instruction, geocodes, affected zones and the storm polygon when the alert has one.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alert` | object | One NWS CAP alert as served by /alerts, fields as the source names them (snake_cased). |
| `location` | object | Echo of the alert polygon (kind Polygon) when the alert has one; null otherwise (no geometry was supplied). |
| `missing` | object[] | Layers the source did not provide for this geometry, with the reason, instead of guessed values. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `polygon` | object[] | The alert's own polygon ring as [lon, lat] pairs when it is storm-based; null for zone-based alerts. |
| `sources` | object[] | Every upstream request this result was built from. |
| `spatial_precision` | string | How closely the values describe the input geometry: polygon (the value's own polygon was intersected with the geometry), grid_cell (the ~2.5 km NWS forecast grid cell containing the centroid), county (an NWS zone or county that contains a sampled point of the geometry), point (the centroid alone), station (an NWS observation station near the geometry, or the station the call was keyed by; see station.distance_m). |

alert.description:
...Forecast flooding changed from Minor to Moderate severity and
increased in duration for the following rivers in Missouri...

Platte River near Platte City affecting Platte County.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Platte River near Platte City.

* WHEN...From Thursday afternoon to Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, Cropland near State Highway 92 near Platte
City begins to flood. At 22.0 feet, Flooding occurs at Humphreys
Access Area which is located 5 miles downstream from Platte City.
300 acres of pasture are also flooded. At 25.0 feet, Water overtops
1st Street in Tracy, Missouri.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 AM CST Wednesday the stage was 15.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 25.0 feet early Saturday
morning. It will then fall below flood stage late Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

post.description: Which watches, warnings and advisories (red flag, fire weather, flood, heat, severe storms) are in effect right now for this paddock, parcel or point, optionally including those within up to 5 km. For past alerts use alerts_history; for one alert's full text use alert.

buffer_km.description:
Also keep storm-based alerts whose polygon lies within this many kilometres of the geometry, and resolve zones for points this far outside its bounding box.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 5; default 0.

events.description: Keep only these event names (case-insensitive substring match on the NWS event name, e.g. "Red Flag", "Flood", "Heat").

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon or MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored. A FeatureCollection is refused (send one place per call), as is a geometry crossing the antimeridian. Invalid input is `invalid_input` with a JSON pointer and a stable code (ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, too_many_vertices, outside_coverage).

severity.description: Keep only alerts with one of these CAP severities.

200.description:
Active NWS watches, warnings and advisories (status actual) for a GeoJSON geometry. Samples the centroid and ring vertices, resolves their county, forecast and fire zones with /zones?point=, reads /alerts/active?zone=... and keeps zone-based alerts (match zone, precision county) plus storm-based alerts whose polygon intersects the geometry or lies within buffer_km of it (match polygon, precision polygon).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `alerts` | object[] |  |
| `buffer_km` | number |  |
| `count` | number |  |

| `missing` | object[] | Layers the source did not provide for this geometry, with the reason, instead of guessed values. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `sources` | object[] | Every upstream request this result was built from. |
| `spatial_precision` | string | How closely the values describe the input geometry: polygon (the value's own polygon was intersected with the geometry), grid_cell (the ~2.5 km NWS forecast grid cell containing the centroid), county (an NWS zone or county that contains a sampled point of the geometry), point (the centroid alone), station (an NWS observation station near the geometry, or the station the call was keyed by; see station.distance_m). |
| `updated` | string | The alerts feed's `updated` stamp. |
| `zones` | object[] |  |
